component.name: lbreco
component.summary: Find your next 50 songs from ListenBrainz

description.p: lbreco reads your ListenBrainz listening history and recommends real tracks from artists in your lane. Keep the songs you like in a playlist and export it for Spotify, YouTube Music, TuneMyMusic or Soundiiz.
An optional OpenAI-compatible model can re-rank and explain the shortlist. Without AI, a deterministic diversity-aware curator still returns the requested number of picks.
